verdict.rationale: Mercury offers free savings accounts and up to 3.89% yield through Treasury, and its internal-transfer API moves funds between checking, savings, and treasury accounts, so automated sweeps can be scripted. Native auto-funding rules across purpose-named accounts are attested only by one long-time customer, not by first-party documentation. Missing for 10: first-party docs for rule-based automated transfers into savings or treasury, and evidence that the savings sub-account itself earns high yield rather than only the separate Treasury product.
